summary_short.zh: AI-Trader 是一个全自动智能交易系统，核心利用大语言模型作为交易代理，自主分析市场数据、新闻和技术指标，无需人工干预即可执行投资决策。技术亮点在于基于代理的架构，将LLM与金融数据管道深度集成，支持多策略并行运行。开发者可使用内置回测框架验证策略，或通过插件机制接入自定义数据源与交易算法。该项目适合对AI量化交易感兴趣的开发者，用于研究LLM在金融决策中的潜力或快速搭建个人自动化交易实验平台。

summaries.en: AI-Trader is a fully-automated, agent-native trading system that uses large language models to make investment decisions without human intervention. Its core innovation is an agent-based architecture where LLMs analyze market data, news, and technical indicators to generate trades. The system supports multiple strategies and can be backtested or deployed live. Developers can extend it by integrating custom data sources or trading algorithms, making it ideal for experimenting with AI-driven quantitative finance.

summaries.en: CloakBrowser is a stealth Chromium browser designed to evade bot detection systems like Cloudflare. It patches browser fingerprinting at the source level, making automated scripts indistinguishable from human users. As a drop-in replacement for Playwright, it passes 30/30 detection tests. Developers can integrate it into web scraping or testing workflows to bypass anti-bot measures without sacrificing reliability.

summaries.en: AI-DLC Workflows provides adaptive workflow steering rules for AI coding agents, solving the problem of agents getting stuck in loops or producing low-quality code. It uses a lifecycle-based approach with checkpoints and feedback loops to guide agents through planning, coding, testing, and debugging. You can integrate these rules into your agent framework to improve code generation reliability and reduce manual intervention.

summary_short.zh: Flutter Skills 是一套面向 Flutter 和 Dart 学习者的动手编码练习集，旨在通过实战任务弥合理论与实践的鸿沟。其核心设计理念是渐进式学习：每个技能点都建立在之前的基础上，逐步覆盖 Widget 构建、状态管理、平台集成等关键主题。开发者可以直接克隆仓库，按顺序完成练习，或修改代码以验证自己的理解。特别适合自学或工作坊场景，帮助学习者从“看懂代码”进阶到“能写项目”。无需复杂环境，一个 Flutter SDK 即可开始。

summaries.en: Flutter Skills is a collection of hands-on coding exercises for learning Flutter and Dart. It solves the problem of bridging theory and practice by providing structured, real-world tasks. Technically, it emphasizes incremental learning, with each skill building on previous ones, covering widgets, state management, and platform integration. Developers can clone the repo, follow the skill progression, and modify exercises to test their understanding. Ideal for self-learners or workshop facilitators seeking practical, project-based Flutter training.
